core.title: Traditional Cabinet Pull with White Porcelain, RK International CP-11

text.description_html:
RK International CP-11, 3" Traditional White Porcelain Pull

There is something so romantic about porcelain. After all, it is a symbol of beauty and elegance. RK International's Traditional Cabinet Pull with White Porcelain has a 3 inch center to center and is available with oil rubbed bronze, satin nickel, or polished brass finish accents. Add classic beauty to your home with these cabinet door pulls.

Also Available Matching Traditional Cabinet Knob with White Porcelain

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-11 Porcelain Middle Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Brass with Porcelain
  • Porcelain Color: White
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-5/8"
  • Width: 9/16"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
